title: resasm sensitivity result (v1)
description: What the replay tool returns: displacement sensitivities du/dp (summarised by norm in JSON; full arrays available from the API/npz), requested output sensitivities dq/dp, the replay-equilibrium and stress-parity checks, model identity, and timings. Produced by residual_core.replay.engine.ReplayResult.to_dict().

value.description: the response value at the converged state

equilibrium.description: residual balance at the converged state (V3, free-DOF half)

stress_check.description: replay stress vs the production stress carried in the record

diagnostics.description: model identity, hashes, dimensions and timings
